Name: Tidy Pam Config
Author: WSAEZ
Description:
[size=4][b]Turn the interior and the exterior of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2306]Tidy Pam[/url] on or off, separately, from the Generic Mod Config Menu.[/b][/size]

Tidy Pam changes both the outside and the inside of Pam's house, with no way to keep one and drop the other. This mod adds that switch. It contains [b]no art and no map[/b]: when you turn something off it puts back what the game, or your other mods, already had there.

[size=5][b]Install[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url].[/*]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2306]Tidy Pam[/url] (required) and, optionally, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] (optional, for the in-game options).[/*]
[*]Unzip this mod into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].[/*]
[/list]Uninstall by deleting the folder. Tidy Pam keeps working on its own.

[size=5][b]Configuration[/b][/size]
Both options are in Generic Mod Config Menu, or in [font=Courier New]config.json[/font].
[list]
[*][b]Interior[/b] (default: on). On: Pam's house interior uses Tidy Pam's layout. Off: the interior goes back to the original map of the game.[/*]
[*][b]Exterior[/b] (default: on). On: the outside of Pam's house uses Tidy Pam's art. Off: it goes back to its look without Tidy Pam: the art of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14524]Elle's Town Buildings[/url] if it is installed and its [b]Pam's House Upgrade[/b] option is on, otherwise the original game art.[/*]
[/list]Changes made in the menu apply right away; if something looks stale, sleep one night.

[size=5][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Needs Tidy Pam ([font=Courier New]Fippsie.TinyPam[/font]). Elle's Town Buildings ([font=Courier New]Elle.TownBuildings[/font]) is optional.[/*]
[*]Works with the four seasons and all languages.[/*]
[*]Stardew Valley Expanded and other mods that replace Pam's house map are respected: the "original" interior is the map as those mods loaded it.[/*]
[/list][size=5][b]Known limitations[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]For the exterior, Elle's Town Buildings' art for Pam's house is read from that mod's installed folder (its own [font=Courier New]config.json[/font] decides the palette and whether the Pam option is on). A recolor mod that repaints this spot after Elle's Town Buildings is not reproduced.[/*]
[*]The interior is restored for the same tiles Tidy Pam patches (10x10 tiles at 20,12 of [font=Courier New]Maps/Trailer_big[/font]). Another mod that edits those same tiles would also be reset.[/*]
[*]Not tested with other mods that replace Pam's house exterior.[/*]
[/list][size=5][b]Credits and permissions[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2306]Tidy Pam[/url] by Fippsie. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14524]Elle's Town Buildings[/url] by Elle/Junimods.[/*]
[*]This mod includes no files, images or maps from any of them, nor from the game. Nothing needs permission. It only reads, on your own computer, what you have installed, and it does not copy or redistribute it.[/*]
[*]Parts of this mod's code and texts were created with AI assistance, reviewed by the author.[/*]
[/list][size=5][b]Changelog[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]1.0.0: first release.[/*]
[/list][line]
[size=5][b]Português (Brasil)[/b][/size]

[b]Liga ou desliga, separadamente, o interior e o exterior do Tidy Pam, pelo Generic Mod Config Menu.[/b]

O Tidy Pam muda por dentro e por fora a casa da Pam, sem como manter só um dos lados. Este mod não traz nenhuma arte nem mapa: ao desligar uma opção, devolve o que o jogo ou seus outros mods já tinham ali.
[list]
[*][b]Interior[/b] (padrão: ligado): desligado, o interior volta ao mapa original do jogo.[/*]
[*][b]Exterior[/b] (padrão: ligado): desligado, o lado de fora volta ao visual sem o Tidy Pam: a arte do Elle's Town Buildings, se instalado e com a opção Pam's House Upgrade ligada; senão, a arte original do jogo.[/*]
[/list]Requer SMAPI e Tidy Pam. Generic Mod Config Menu e Elle's Town Buildings são opcionais. Credita Fippsie (Tidy Pam) e Elle/Junimods (Elle's Town Buildings); nenhum arquivo deles ou do jogo é distribuído aqui.
